content.text: {"title":"AERO9500 Final Report (Part 2)","overview":"Design a simple preliminary space mission benefiting Australia and identify main elements of its space segment, demonstrating understanding of space segment systems (launch, orbits etc.) using mission design software plus hand calculations.","deliverables":["Technical report as single PDF including/referencing relevant screenshots","All relevant STK or PIGI design files (in report or appendix)"],"format":{"length":"20 pages max for core part - excludes title page, table of contents, references, etc.","structure":"Must include sections: Executive summary; Introduction - mission overview and rationale; Main body [launch, orbit, ground stations, coverage, mission operation and end-of-life]; Conclusion; Bibliography","other":"Engineering technical report style - clear, effective, correct grammar and spelling. Figures and tables fully and correctly labelled with number, title and reference if needed. All non-original text/diagrams/ideas cited and referenced; Wikipedia not acceptable as source. Plagiarism check."},"requirements":[{"id":"R1","text":"Define spacecraft's primary mission - must benefit Australia, keep concept simple (examples: bushfire tracking/alert, weather satellite, internet/communication, Earth observation for city planning/real estate)."},{"id":"R2","text":"State whether one or multiple spacecraft will be used."},{"id":"R3","text":"Identify users (operator and customers)."},{"id":"R4","text":"Specify launch location and launch vehicle."},{"id":"R5","text":"Specify orbit type, its characteristics and orbital elements."},{"id":"R6","text":"Determine if any orbital maneuvers are required and detail them."},{"id":"R7","text":"Identify which ground control facilities will be used and how often spacecraft can communicate with ground control, including coverage analysis."},{"id":"R8","text":"Define mission duration and plans for End-of-Life (EOL)."},{"id":"R9","text":"Use mission design software of choice (STK industry-standard, PIGI from Saber Astronautics requires competition registration for license, or other e.g. flightclub only after contacting Naomi) to complete design, supplemented with hand calculations as needed."},{"id":"R10","text":"Include in main body all space segment aspects: launch, orbit, ground stations, coverage, mission operation and end-of-life."}]}
